test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ts_bucketing (id UInt64, timestamp DateTime64(3), value Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (id, timestamp)
CREATE TABLE ts_bucketing_unsorted (id UInt64, h UInt64, timestamp DateTime64(3), value Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (id, h)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ts_bucketing SELECT number % 2500 AS id, toDateTime64(intDiv(number, 2500) * 15, 3) AS timestamp, (intDiv(number, 2500) % 1000)::Float64 AS value FROM numbers_mt(2500 * 20000)

INSERT INTO ts_bucketing_unsorted SELECT number % 2500 AS id, intHash64(number) AS h, toDateTime64(intDiv(number, 2500) * 15, 3) AS timestamp, (intDiv(number, 2500) % 1000)::Float64 AS value FROM numbers_mt(2500 * 8000)
